faqs.q: What is the Office of the Children's Guardian?
faqs.a: The Office of the Children's Guardian (OCG) is a statutory body that works to protect children and promote their welfare in NSW.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about child safety?
faqs.a: You can find more information about child safety and related services on the OCG website.

faqs.q: How can I contact the Office of the Children's Guardian?
faqs.a: You can find contact details for the Office of the Children's Guardian on their dedicated contact page.
